title: Les Mills vs City Fitness NZ — Which Is Better Value in 2026?
meta_desc: Compare Les Mills and City Fitness NZ prices, facilities, and contracts
intro: With numerous gym options available in New Zealand, choosing the best one can be overwhelming. Les Mills and City Fitness NZ are two popular options, offering a range of facilities and services. But which one provides better value for money?

sections.heading: Facilities and Locations
sections.body: Both Les Mills and City Fitness NZ have multiple locations across New Zealand, with Les Mills having over 40 locations and City Fitness NZ having over 20 locations. Les Mills facilities typically include cardio equipment, free weights, and group fitness studios, while City Fitness NZ facilities include cardio equipment, free weights, and personal training areas.

sections.heading: Group Fitness Classes
sections.body: Les Mills is renowned for its high-quality group fitness classes, including BodyPump, BodyCombat, and RPM. City Fitness NZ also offers a range of group fitness classes, including yoga, Pilates, and spin classes. However, Les Mills classes are often more frequent and varied, with over 100 classes per week at some locations.

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Cancellation
sections.body: Les Mills contracts typically range from 12-24 months, with a minimum notice period of 30 days for cancellation. City Fitness NZ contracts range from 6-12 months, with a minimum notice period of 14 days for cancellation. It's essential to review the contract terms before signing up to ensure you understand the commitment and cancellation policies.

sections.heading: Cities Covered
list: Les Mills: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Tauranga, and more
City Fitness NZ: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, and Queenstown

sections.heading: Conclusion and Comparison
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Les Mills and City Fitness NZ depends on your individual needs and preferences. If you prioritize high-quality group fitness classes and a wider range of facilities, Les Mills may be the better option. However, if you're looking for a more affordable gym membership with flexible contract terms, City Fitness NZ could be the way to go.
